title: Operación Cóndor
goal: Read how the Southern Cone dictatorships built a coordinated network, Operation Condor, to share intelligence and track down exiled dissidents across borders, and how the Terror Archives later documented it.

items: Explain how the intelligence agencies of the participating countries communicated.
Explain what the participating dictatorships coordinated to do.
Describe how opponents were pursued abroad even after seeking refuge in another state.
Explain what the Terror Archives made possible.
Use por medio de to name a concrete mechanism.
